acceptance: One PR containing both members has merged to develop.
Each member's own acceptance criteria are met on the merged head, with the evidence in the PR.
context: Owner decision (2026-11-13): feature branch per group, built by one delegated agent; the session that owns this plan is the only tracker writer. Guardrails: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items are delivered together on one feature branch and one PR, as their umbrella item names (site work: BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site); squash-merged. Add a changelog.d fragment for any user-facing change. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers) runs only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy (make comment-policy-check). Stop and report instead of widening scope; scope removed during review must be re-homed to a named item or dropped by the owner with a reason.
description:
Feature-branch umbrella (not itself a change). Members, delivered together on feat/agent-mcp-surface with one PR to develop: mcp-prompts-name-nonexistent-tools-20261112 and mcp-run-benchmark-seed-iterations-20261112. Order on the branch: prompts and instructions first, then seed and iterations.

After the PR merges: finish this umbrella, then take and finish each member.
